title: Church Planting
definition: Church Planting is the mission work of establishing new local churches where believers gather, grow, worship, and witness under Christ.
summary: Church Planting is the establishment of new local churches where the Gospel can take root in worshiping, discipling communities.
christFocus: Jesus Christ builds His Church and sends His people to make disciples among the nations.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church planting is the work of establishing new local churches where believers can gather, worship, be taught, and bear witness to Christ. Scripture shows the Gospel creating communities, not merely individual converts.

Planting churches is not about expanding a brand or competing with other congregations. It is about forming Gospel-centered communities where Christ is proclaimed and disciples are made.

Jesus builds His church. Church planting depends on His authority, His Word, His Spirit, and His mission.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Evangelism without gathered discipleship leaves new believers without shepherding and community. Church planting helps the Gospel take root in places and among people who need ongoing biblical care.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Support church planting with prayer, generosity, sending, and patience. Care more about faithful churches than impressive launches, and measure success by Gospel clarity, discipleship, and Christlike fruit.
